content_md:
**The digital stack reads as two machines, not one**

A conjecture, reviewed and weakened. The incumbent stack's hardware-and-scaling layer is compatible with Modernity in Dusk, but the evidence is now capital and supply-chain concentration (training cost up 2.4x a year; energy only 2-6% of run cost; a concentrated chip supply chain), which ordinary market structure also explains. The Divergence-in-Day reading of the deployment layer is currently unsupported. Not tested.

Evidence: [the working analysis](https://github.com/msmsim/kinocomputing-lab/blob/main/analyses/a001-incumbent-stack-in-the-machines/ANALYSIS.md). Stage: conjecture. Review: weakened.
